ItemTags.Name: Tags (BM5e)
ItemTags.Hint: Enter a tag and click Add. Match it in enchantment preferences with tag:true-strike, for example. Tags are case-sensitive.

chat.Name: Chat & Rolls
chat.Hint: Configure your chat interactions, roll tooltips, automatic damage rolls and popouts.

hud.Name: Token HUD
hud.Hint: Configure your token status sorting, scaling and filtering.

damage.Name: Damage Mechanics
damage.Hint: Configure damage application, calculation and integrated protection features.

conditions.Name: Conditions & Effects
conditions.Hint: Configure Prone, Grappled, Falling, effect application and enchantments.

SettingsMenus.DebugHint: Enable BM5E overtime debug logs. Can be combined with channel flags via globalThis.bm5e.debug.

RefreshLinkedTokenFalling.Name: Re-evaluate Falling when the active scene loads
RefreshLinkedTokenFalling.Hint: The active GM refreshes shared Falling statuses using only linked tokens in the active scene when it loads. Keeps the system's last-moved token if it belongs to that scene; otherwise uses a linked token from that scene. This updates the system's last-moved token reference; statuses remain shared across scenes. Does nothing when the system's Disable Falling setting is enabled: no Falling checks, status changes, or last-moved token updates.

HarmlessFalling.Name: Harmless Falling on Right-click
HarmlessFalling.Hint: Allow GMs to right-click the Falling icon to land without damage. Left-click retains normal falling damage.

LinksMenu.Name: Module Support
LinksMenu.Label: Links
LinksMenu.Hint: Open BM5E documentation, issue tracker, and support links.
LinksMenu.Title: Resources & Support
LinksMenu.SupportMessage: Toss a Coin to your Bugbear

IntegratedDamageModifiers.Name: Standard Damage Automations
IntegratedDamageModifiers.Hint: Choose which D&D 5e damage automations BM5E handles without requiring Mutable Damage Calculation.

HideChatTags.Name: Hide chat-card tags for
HideChatTags.Hint: Hide item and activity tags (such as weapon type, range and proficiency) for the selected groups. Leave empty to show tags to everyone. Applies immediately.

CompactCombinedCards.Name: Compact combined cards
CompactCombinedCards.Hint: Show linked attack and damage rolls side by side, with target hit/miss indicators and damage previews in one row of pills, compact multiplier controls, and a checkmark beside damage for Apply and Restore actions. Applies immediately to this client.

ChatDoubleClick.Name: Enable chat document double-clicks
ChatDoubleClick.Hint: Double-click document icons and names in chat messages to open their sheets or images.

Enabled.Name: Show chat action labels
Enabled.Hint: Show text labels on compact Attack, Damage, Save, and Check buttons. Applies only to your user and updates immediately.

MutableDamageCalculation.Name: Mutable Damage Calculation
MutableDamageCalculation.Hint: Adds D&D 5e mutable damage-calculation hooks required by automations such as Arcane Ward and Undead Fortitude. Requires libWrapper and reloads the world when changed.
MutableDamageCalculation.LibWrapperRequired: BM5E mutable damage calculation requires libWrapper to be enabled.

Features.Name: Mutable Damage Automations
Features.Hint: Choose which D&D 5e damage automations BM5E handles using Mutable Damage Calculation.

DamageApplication.ArcaneWardNote: Arcane Ward absorbed {absorbed} damage. Damage applied: {applied}. Ward HP: {remaining}/{maximum}.
DamageApplication.ArcaneWardPreview: Arcane Ward would absorb {absorbed} damage. Remaining damage: {applied}. Ward HP afterward: {remaining}/{maximum}.

Enabled.Name: Enable damage restoration
Enabled.Hint: Record native D&D5e damage applications and add a Restore button to the damage tray.

EffectApplicationOutcomes.Name: Deselect effect targets by roll outcome
EffectApplicationOutcomes.Hint: Automatically deselect missed attack targets and targets that succeed on saving throws from effect application trays.

StandingFromProne.Name: Implement Prone Mechanics
StandingFromProne.Hint: Applying Prone selects Crawl for the actor's tokens. Removing Prone restores their previous movement action, or selects their fastest available action. Click a token's Prone icon to stand, spending half its walking speed; enough movement must remain.

Setting.Name: Implement Grapple Mechanics
Setting.Hint: Actor owners and the active GM can click a token's Grappled icon to roll an escape using the configured 2014 or 2024 rules. The active GM can right-click to set or edit the escape DC. Under 2024 rules, grapples also end when the grappler is Incapacitated or moves out of range.

Grapple.NoSource: The grappler could not be resolved from this effect.
Grapple.NoDC: The grapple's escape DC could not be resolved.
Grapple.NoGM: An active GM is required to set this grapple's escape DC.

ActivationTriggers.HPFiltersHint: Compare current HP to maximum HP, excluding temporary HP. Activity actor is the owner of this triggered activity; opponent is each creature involved in the event. Movement has no opponent.
ActivationTriggers.Title: BM5E Activation Triggers
ActivationTriggers.AutoTargetHint: Receiver events target the source creature. Source events target the affected creature. Movement and In Range target the triggering token.
ActivationTriggers.BypassConfigureHint: Skips activity configuration choices such as advantage, scaling, and resource options.
ActivationTriggers.AutoRollHint: Creates the Triggered chat message and immediately uses the activity. Otherwise, wait for a user to select it.
ActivationTriggers.DamageReductionHint: Formula for one reduction budget. Selected damage types share it; no types selected means all damage types. Requires Mutable Damage Calculation.
ActivationTriggers.DeleteAfterTriggersHint: Delete this emanation after this many trigger offers across all tokens and turns, including outside combat. Each eligible token counts separately, even if its offered activity is not used. Set to 0 for no limit.

Switch.Name: Enable Status HUD Sorting
Switch.Hint: When enabled, the status effects labels will also be shown and an opinionated sorting will take place!

SortingType.Name: Status Effects sorting
SortingType.Hint: Fill by rows (left -> right) or by columns (top -> bottom)

NumberColumns.Name: Number of columns
NumberColumns.Hint: Divide the HUD status effects number into this number of columns

Scale.Name: HUD scale
Scale.Hint: Scale the Status HUD as a percentage of its default size.

ScaleEnabled.Name: Enable HUD scaling
ScaleEnabled.Hint: Scale the Status HUD and compensate for canvas zoom.

Filter.Name: Enable status filter
Filter.Hint: Show or hide the status filter input on the Token HUD.

AutoRollDamage.Name: Auto Roll Damage
AutoRollDamage.Hint: Choose when attack damage rolls automatically. In either enabled mode, save activities open the damage dialog when used, before saves resolve. Disabled while Midi-QOL is active.
AutoRollDamage.Prompt: You have already rolled damage for this attack. What do you want to do? Close dialog to cancel!

AutoPopout.Name: Enable use message pop-outs
AutoPopout.Hint: Automatically pop out usage messages for configured defaults, manually enabled activities, and extra attacks.

Identifiers.Name: Auto pop-out use messages
Identifiers.Label: Configure
Identifiers.Hint: Configure items and activities whose use messages should pop out by default.
Identifiers.Title: Auto Pop-out Use Messages
Identifiers.HintText: Enter an item or activity name, id, identifier, or UUID, or an actor UUID, id, or name. You can also drag a compendium document here. Activity Behavior settings override these defaults.
Identifiers.ImportFailed: The selected file is not a valid use message pop-out defaults export.
Identifiers.ExtraAttackHint: Match a Feature on the actor. Its melee and ranged weapon attacks will pop out.

Activity.Name: Use message pop-out
Activity.Hint: Open this activity's use message in a separate window for reuse.
Activity.Tooltip: Useful for repeated attacks or reusing activities such as Spirit Guardians. This activity preference overrides configured pop-out defaults; the user's global pop-out setting must also be enabled.

RerollControls.Name: Show reroll controls
RerollControls.Hint: Show clickable dice buttons and reroll menus on chat rolls you can update. Applies only to your user and updates immediately.

ChatMessagesTooltips.Name: Show roll results on message buttons
ChatMessagesTooltips.Hint: Show Attack and Damage roll history in button tooltips and mark rolled Save and Check buttons. Applies only to your user and updates immediately.

EffectsEditor.Title: BM5E Effect Editor
EffectsEditor.AttributeKeyHint: For BM5E overtime details, open the local README.

Readme.MissingDocument: BM5E README document was not found.
Readme.MissingPack: BM5E README pack was not found: {pack}

EffectsEditor.ActivitySourceHint: Create an activity on this effect's Item, or on the actor's BM5E Overtime Item for actor-owned effects.
EffectsEditor.PreserveDCHint: Resolve the linked activity's DC using its source actor before creating the overtime activity.
EffectsEditor.OutOfCombatHint: Keep the combat trigger and allow use outside combat too. Damage and healing can also run on a configured world-time interval.
EffectsEditor.NoActivityParent: BM5E could not find an item to create the overtime activity on.
EffectsEditor.GeneratedValueHint: Preview of the overtime value generated from the editor fields.

ItemMaterials.Name: Enable item material properties
ItemMaterials.Hint: Add Wooden, Metal, Glass, and Crystal properties to weapons and equipment. Mark item materials manually, then use them in the Enchant activity's existing item-property restrictions. Disabled by default. Requires a reload.

Enchantment.AnyTypePropertiesHint: Bugbear's Mechanics addition. Property restrictions are also available for Any item type, allowing one activity to affect matching items across different types.

Enabled.Name: Enable enchantment handling
Enabled.Hint: Enable enchantment target selection, preferred-item matching, application limits, stack controls, and tray additions.

Stackable.Name: Allow enchantment stacks
Stackable.Hint: Allow this enchantment to be applied to the same item more than once.
Stackable.Tooltip: Allow several active copies of this enchantment on the same item. For target enchantments, each copy counts toward the per-use application limit, while the overall item limit counts that item only once. Self-enchantments ignore these limits.

PreferredItem.Name: Preferred item identifiers or tags
PreferredItem.Hint: Match any listed identifier or tag, separated by commas. Example: shield*, tag:true-strike. Leave blank for normal selection.
PreferredItem.Tooltip: An item can match any entry. Prefix a tag with tag: to match an exact, case-sensitive BM5e or BLT5e tag. Everything after the prefix is literal: tag:true-strike:2 matches the item tag true-strike:2. Use * only for partial identifier matches; shield* matches shield, shield-wooden, and tower-shield. Plain identifiers match exactly. A single compatible match is chosen automatically. Multiple tag or wildcard matches limit the picker to matches; plain identifiers alone put matches first. With no matches, the normal picker opens. Dropping another compatible item remains allowed.

ApplyAllPreferred.Name: Apply to all matching items
ApplyAllPreferred.Hint: Automatically enchant every compatible match, within recipient and item limits.
ApplyAllPreferred.Tooltip: Applies matching items sequentially without a picker, until a recipient or item limit prevents further applications. Set both item limits high enough, or use 0 for unlimited. Blank identifiers or no matches open the normal single-item picker. Self-enchantments are unchanged.

MaximumItems.Name: Maximum enchanted items
MaximumItems.Hint: Maximum different items enchanted at once across all uses and recipients. Blank: 1. Use 0 for unlimited.
MaximumItems.Tooltip: Counts different items across every use of this activity. Multiple stacks on one item count as one item. Removing all stacks from an item frees a slot. Lowering the limit does not remove existing enchantments.
MaximumItems.Reached: This enchantment has reached its maximum number of enchanted items.

MaximumItemsPerUse.Name: Maximum enchanted items per use
MaximumItemsPerUse.Hint: Maximum active applications from one use, including repeated stacks. Blank or 0: unlimited. The overall item limit still applies.
MaximumItemsPerUse.Tooltip: Counts active applications from the current use message across all recipients. Repeated stacks on one item each count. A new use message has its own allowance. Removing an application frees a slot; earlier uses still count toward the overall item limit.
MaximumItemsPerUse.Reached: This use has reached its maximum number of enchanted items.

Enchantment.ChooseRecipients: Choose at least one targeted or selected token before choosing items to enchant.
Enchantment.UndoHint:
Shift+Click: Undo all
Ctrl+Shift+Click: Undo all (per item)
Enchantment.TargetLimitReached: This use has reached the activity's maximum number of recipients.
Enchantment.Unauthorized: Only the target owner, source actor owner, or a GM can apply this enchantment.
